heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, with some high clouds south. Increasing clouds through Quebec, south into the Adirondacks and Rt. 4, with a few isolated showers near and north of the Quebec border late. Lows in the upper 40s to mid 50s. Winds northwest, becoming west near 10 mph, diminishing to light outside the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday
text: Some morning clouds, an isolated shower or sprinkle north, then sun mixed with clouds. More clouds through NY and the St. Lawrence Valley. Highs in the upper 60s to mid 70s. Light winds, mainly north up to 10 mph.

heading: TuesdayNight
text: Fair east early, then increasing clouds. Lows in the 40s to low 50s east of the Green Mountains, and 50s to near 60 from the Green Mountains west. Winds light and variable, becoming south up to 10 mph late through the Champlain Valley, and over the higher terrain.
